summary.goal: Backend service for managing agent questions with intelligent prioritization, deduplication via user trajectory, and multi-agent answer subscription.

acceptance_criteria.description: Questions scored with priority formula: blocking_level_value*100 + steps_blocked*10 + subscribers.length*15 + cascade_depth*5 - (can_use_default ? 30 : 0)
Before adding to queue, check user trajectory for existing answer (similarity > 0.85)
If similar question already in queue, subscribe agent to that answer
Blocking levels: hard_block (3), soft_block (2), preference (1), fyi (0)
When answered: update user trajectory, notify subscribed agents via relay, update preference model
API: POST /questions (internal - called by MCP), GET /questions/pending, POST /questions/:id/answer
SSE events for new questions and answers
Default choice support: agent can proceed with default after timeout if can_use_default=true

observations: Question queue is backend counterpart to forge-ui-question-queue
Multiple agents can wait for same answer (subscribers array)
patterns: Pub/sub for answer notification via relay
SSE for real-time updates to UI

architect.notes: agents_waiting shown in UI = subscribers.length from question entity

criteria.evidence: services/question-service.ts:154-192 checks user trajectory with 0.85 threshold
domain/types.ts:887-892 BLOCKING_LEVEL_VALUES: HardBlock(3), SoftBlock(2), Preference(1), FYI(0)
services/question-service.ts:324-400 answerQuestion updates trajectory, notifies subscribers
api/handlers/sse.ts:106 maps HumanInputRequested to QuestionAdded; mcp/tools/request-human-input.ts:164-177 emits SSE
services/question-service.ts:461-532 processTimeouts + autoDefaultQuestion with configurable timeout

drift.finding: SSE event naming differs at layers: MCP emits 'question_added', SSE handler maps HumanInputRequested to QuestionAdded

steps.title: Implement priority scoring
steps.description: Calculate priority score for question ordering

acceptance_criteria.description: calculatePriorityScore(question) implements formula
Formula: blocking_level_value*100 + steps_blocked*10 + subscribers.length*15 + cascade_depth*5 - (can_use_default ? 30 : 0)
Blocking level values: hard_block=3, soft_block=2, preference=1, fyi=0
Score recalculated when subscribers added or steps_blocked changes

steps.title: Implement trajectory-aware deduplication with transparency
steps.description: Check user trajectory before adding to queue, with explicit auto-answer visibility

acceptance_criteria.description: Before adding question, call userTrajectory.findSimilarQuestions(text, threshold=0.85)
If similar answer exists in trajectory: create question with status='auto_answered_from_trajectory'
Store trajectory event 'question_auto_answered' with { question_text, matched_question_id, similarity_score, auto_answer }
Emit SSE event 'question_auto_answered' so UI can display auto-answered questions in history
Notify agent immediately with auto-answer via relay, include { source: 'trajectory', matched_question_id }
Auto-answered questions visible in GET /questions/history (not just skipped silently)

architecture.transparency: Auto-answered questions are stored and visible, not silently skipped. Users can review and override auto-answers.

steps.title: Implement question subscription
steps.description: Allow multiple agents to subscribe to same question

acceptance_criteria.description: Before creating new question, check if similar question already pending
If similar pending: subscribeToQuestion(questionId, agentId) adds to subscribers array
Recalculate priority_score after adding subscriber
When answered, all subscribers notified via relay message

architecture.similarity: Use same text similarity as trajectory dedup

steps.title: Implement answer flow
steps.description: Handle question answering with side effects

acceptance_criteria.description: answerQuestion(questionId, answer, answeredBy) updates status to 'answered'
Records answer in user trajectory via userTrajectory.recordUserDecision()
Notifies all subscribers via relay message { type: 'question_answered', question_id, answer }
Updates preference model if applicable
Unblocks waiting tasks by setting task.status back to 'running'

specification.pattern_description: Copy answer handler pattern from planner-core

steps.title: Create question queue API endpoints
steps.description: REST API for question queue management

acceptance_criteria.description: POST /questions creates question (called internally by MCP tool handler)
GET /questions/pending returns sorted by priority score, includes subscribers.length as agents_waiting
GET /questions/history returns all questions including auto_answered_from_trajectory for transparency
POST /questions/:id/answer submits answer
All emit SSE events for real-time UI updates

specification.pattern_description: Copy question handler pattern from planner-core

steps.title: Implement default value handling with visibility
steps.description: Support agents proceeding with default if can_use_default and timeout reached, with explicit status

acceptance_criteria.description: Scheduled job checks for pending questions past timeout
If can_use_default=true and created_at + timeout < now, use default_value
Set status to 'auto_defaulted' (distinct from 'answered')
Store trajectory event 'question_auto_defaulted' with { question_id, default_value, timeout_duration }
Emit SSE event 'question_auto_defaulted' for UI visibility
Notify agent with { type: 'question_answered', answer, source: 'timeout_default' }
Configurable timeout: FORGE_QUESTION_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT (default 5 min)

architecture.pattern: Scheduled job checks for timed-out defaultable questions
architecture.visibility: auto_defaulted is a distinct status visible in UI - not hidden as 'answered'
